business_problem: LSEG needed to reduce manual synthesis and fragmented workflows across its financial-data organization while making trusted market data easier for employees and customers to use inside AI workflows.
solution_summary: LSEG paired ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API with its financial-data platform to change how analysts, product teams, engineers, and business users work. Internally, thousands of employees use the system to summarize market and financial information, draft reports, prototype features, produce client documentation, and streamline operational tasks. Externally, LSEG is using OpenAI to help customers access trusted data in the environments where they already work, including through its Model Context Protocol integration. The company treated this as a governed platform rollout rather than an experimentation program, embedding model-evaluation frameworks, strict privacy and security controls, and human-in-the-loop review for critical outputs from the start. That combination of AI access, trusted data, and enterprise governance shortened product cycles, reduced time from customer request to production, and gave the company a faster path from idea to AI-enabled financial products.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Enables employees globally to summarize data, draft reports, and prototype products faster.

solution_components.name: OpenAI API
solution_components.role: Supports internal and customer-facing applications that combine LSEG data with generative AI workflows.

solution_components.name: Model Context Protocol
solution_components.role: Connects trusted LSEG data into customer AI workflows with precise, verifiable context.

data_flow: Trusted market and financial data flows into employee workflows through ChatGPT Enterprise and into product or customer workflows through the OpenAI API and Model Context Protocol. Model-evaluation and governance controls sit around those flows, while human reviewers sign off on critical outputs before broader use.
business_outcome: LSEG accelerated product delivery, cut time-to-market for AI-enabled solutions, improved analyst productivity, and created a governed way to expose trusted financial data inside AI tools that its customers already use.
metrics: Reduced product release cycles from 3–6 months to 2 weeks
